definition: Chinese male detective aged 28, lean build, short straight black hair, narrow oval face, straight eyebrows, dark brown eyes, light blue short-sleeved police shirt with plain dark shoulder tabs, charcoal trousers and black shoes. No readable badge, no lettering, no numbers.

Chinese male detective aged 48, stocky build, square face, short black crew cut with grey temples, heavy brows, light blue short-sleeved police shirt with plain dark shoulder tabs, dark grey trousers and black shoes.

Chinese schoolgirl aged thirteen, ordinary youthful face, straight black hair in a low ponytail, no makeup, loose pale mint short-sleeved cotton T-shirt, straight dark blue jeans and plain white sneakers. Fully clothed, ordinary age-appropriate everyday appearance, no jewelry.

Chinese schoolgirl aged fourteen, round youthful face, straight black shoulder-length bob with full fringe, loose dusty blue short-sleeved cotton shirt buttoned normally, dark grey straight trousers, white sneakers. Fully clothed, no makeup or jewelry.

Chinese grandfather aged seventy, thin build, deeply lined narrow face, short grey hair, faded brown cotton short-sleeved shirt, charcoal loose trousers, black cloth shoes, old straw farming hat carried in hand.
Chinese woman aged forty, sturdy build, round face, black hair in a practical short ponytail, muted plum cotton short-sleeved blouse, plain dark trousers and black flat shoes, no jewelry.

Chinese female middle-school teacher aged forty-four, lean build, long oval face, rectangular black glasses, short black bob tucked behind ears, plain navy cotton shirt and grey trousers, black flat shoes.
Chinese woman aged forty-two, slender build, angular face, black hair tied in a low neat bun, navy short-sleeved blouse, brown trousers, black flat shoes, plain brown handbag.

Chinese retired male teacher aged sixty-eight, slim build, kind lined oval face, thinning short grey hair, thin square silver glasses, light grey summer cardigan over off-white cotton shirt, charcoal trousers and brown cloth shoes.
Chinese male factory worker aged forty-one, medium build, broad face with a receding short black haircut, faint stubble, faded khaki short-sleeved workshirt, dark brown trousers and black work shoes.

Chinese female factory worker aged forty, lean build, tired long face, black hair tied low, plain grey cotton blouse and dark trousers, black flat shoes. Winter state adds a burgundy padded jacket over the same blouse; face and hair remain unchanged.

Chinese man aged fifty, heavy-set build, broad square face, neatly combed black hair with slight grey temples, plain charcoal suit jacket over dark blue open-neck shirt, dark trousers and black shoes.
Chinese man aged forty-five, medium build, short cropped black hair, narrow face, plain grey polo shirt and dark trousers.
